theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Oil Extends Surge as Fresh US Strikes Against Iran Rattle Market
top_news.summary: Oil extended a powerful surge as the US struck targets in Iran for a second day, raising risks for energy supplies from the region.

top_news.title: Harley-Davidson’s Credit Ratings Get Cut to Junk By S&P
top_news.summary: S&P Global Ratings cut Harley-Davidson Inc.’s credit grades to junk status on Wednesday, citing the company’s strategy to start selling lower-cost motorcycles to boost revenue.

top_news.title: Trump Says Ukraine Can Make Patriot Missiles
top_news.summary: American Enterprise Institute Senior Fellow Angela Stent  discusses President Trump's announcement he would allow Ukraine to make its own Patriot Missiles. She says Trump "sees that Ukraine looks like a winner, that it has cards that the Ukrainians are really fighting back." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Trader Joe's, Lowe's Embrace Mini Mania To Boost Sales
top_news.summary: Mini mania is sweeping through US retailers as shoppers on a budget love colorful, charming, tiny versions of common products. Bloomberg’s Sunny Kim has more.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: GrainCorp Pushes for Australia Biofuel Mandates After Iran War
top_news.summary: Australia should adopt national biofuel mandates to bolster its energy security, according to GrainCorp Ltd., after months of uncertainty from the Iran war which sent shockwaves through the country’s economy.

top_news.title: Emerging Currencies Slide as US Forces Launch New Iran Strikes
top_news.summary: Most emerging-market currencies weakened on Wednesday as the US launched a new wave of strikes against Iran after threatening to reimpose an oil embargo, renewing fears of a prolonged conflict and bolstering oil prices.

top_news.title: Media M&A in Focus at Sun Valley
top_news.summary:
Bloomberg's Michelle Davis joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals" to discuss what's top of mind in media M&A as moguls gather in Sun Valley for Allen & Co.'s annual conference.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Stocks Fall as US-Iran Jitters Spur Rally in Oil: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A flare-up in geopolitical risks sent stocks and bonds lower as oil jumped after President Donald Trump said a ceasefire with Iran may be over, raising concerns about a potential return to all-out war.

top_news.title: US Stocks Pare Iran War-Driven Losses After Dip Buyers Emerge
top_news.summary: US equities nearly erased early losses that were driven by fears of US-Iran war escalation that pushed energy prices higher.

top_news.title: Economic Costs For US, Iran Too Great for 'All-Out War,' Says CSIS's Will Todman
top_news.summary: Will Todman, chief of staff of the Geopolitics and Foreign Policy Department and senior fellow of the Middle East Program at CSIS, said that a low level conflict with outbursts from both the US and Iran is more likely than an 'all-out' war because the economic costs to both countries are too great. Todman said that Iran is 'very keen' to keep control over the Strait of Hormuz as an economic and strategic negotiating tool.  (Source: Bloomberg)
